User.title: User
User.description: Account profile and 10 GB storage quota tracking for an authenticated Docucloud user.

uid.description: Primary key corresponding to the Firebase Auth UID.

fullName.description: Full display name of the user.

email.description: Primary email address of the user.

usedStorageBytes.description: Total storage currently consumed by the user in bytes (0 to 10737418240).

maxStorageBytes.description: Maximum allowed storage quota in bytes, strictly fixed at 10737418240 (10 GB).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the account was registered.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the user record was last updated.

username.description: Vault alias handle for the user.

bio.description: Optional occupation or personal vault description.

securityAlerts.description: Whether login and security notifications are enabled.

Document.title: Document
Document.description: Metadata record for an isolated user document stored in Docucloud.

userId.description: Owner UID used for strict per-account isolation and query indexing.

sizeBytes.description: Exact byte size of the file (maximum 10485760 bytes / 10 MB per uploaded file).

starred.description: Whether the document is marked as favorite.

uploadedAt.description: Server timestamp when the document was uploaded.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the document was last modified.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores isolated account profile and 10 GB storage consumption state per authenticated user.

/documents/{documentId}.description: Stores isolated document metadata records strictly owned by a single user.
